Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1743121, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
